metadata.title: Cooke & Zeeman (1976) Clock-and-Wavefront Somite Segmentation Model, Size-Invariance Scaling & Vertebrate Somite Specimen Dataset

sources.citation: Cooke J, Zeeman EC (1976). A clock and wavefront model for control of the number of repeated structures during animal morphogenesis. Journal of Theoretical Biology 58(2):455-476.
Cooke J (1975). Control of somite number during morphogenesis of a vertebrate, Xenopus laevis. Nature 254(5497):196-199.
Palmeirim I, Henrique D, Ish-Horowicz D, Pourquie O (1997). Avian hairy gene expression identifies a molecular clock linked to vertebrate segmentation and somitogenesis. Cell 91(5):639-648.

Goldbeter A, Gonze D, Pourquie O (2007). Sharp developmental thresholds defined through bistability by antagonistic gradients of retinoic acid and FGF signaling. Developmental Dynamics 236(6):1495-1508.

vertebrate_embryo_somites_sem.species: Gallus gallus / Vertebrate embryo dorsal scanning electron micrograph showing neural tube and bilateral segmented somite rows

cooke_zeeman_1976_governing_equations.section: Cooke & Zeeman (1976) J. Theor. Biol. 58:455-476, Sections 2-5
cooke_zeeman_1976_governing_equations.proportional_wavefront_velocity_law: v = L / T_total  =>  N = T_total / T_c  (exact embryo-size invariance for miniature/operated embryos)
cooke_zeeman_1976_governing_equations.cusp_catastrophe_manifold: dchi/dt = -1/tau_chi * (chi^3 - a(x, t) * chi - b_osc(x, t))
cooke_zeeman_1976_governing_equations.wavefront_control_parameter: a(x, t) = tanh((v * t - x) / sigma_w)
cooke_zeeman_1976_governing_equations.clock_phase_modulation: b_osc(x, t) = b_0 + A_c * cos(2 * pi * t / T_c - k_phi * x)

state_variables.chi: Cellular morphogenetic state / cell-adhesion determination order parameter on the Thom-Zeeman cusp manifold
state_variables.phi: Autonomous intracellular segmentation clock phase phi(x, t) = 2*pi*t / T_c - k_phi*x
state_variables.x_w: Anterior-to-posterior determination wavefront position x_w(t) = v * t
state_variables.S: Anteroposterior length of an individual somite metamere (um or normalized axis units)
state_variables.N: Total number of segmented somites along a body axis of length L

cooke_1975_xenopus_size_regulation_table.source: Cooke (1975) Nature 254:196-199 Table 1 & Cooke & Zeeman (1976) J. Theor. Biol. 58:455-476
cooke_1975_xenopus_size_regulation_table.description: Surgically reduced (blastula-operated) Xenopus laevis embryos regulate somite length S in proportion to axial length L while preserving total somite count N ~ 40.

regimes.label: Surgically reduced miniature embryo (60% axial length, Cooke 1975)
Clock period doubled perturbation (T_c = 90 min, fixed v)
Accelerated wavefront perturbation (1.5x v, fixed T_c = 45 min)
